name: MobileRank – Mobile Performance Diagnostics
author: Dmitry

sections.description:
Google ranks mobile-first. Is your WordPress site ready?

MobileRank finds what’s broken on mobile, shows you why it’s hurting your Google rankings, and tells you exactly how to fix it. Three built-in scanners work instantly with zero configuration — no API key needed. Add a free Google PageSpeed API key to unlock full performance scoring with Core Web Vitals.

Your caching plugin makes your site fast. MobileRank makes your mobile site fast and usable.

Works Instantly — No Setup Required

These features run the moment you activate. No API key, no configuration, no waiting:

  • Image Audit — Scans your entire media library for missing alt text, oversized images (>500KB), non-WebP formats, and images missing width/height attributes
  • Content Scanner — Checks every published post and page for unresponsive tables, hardcoded pixel widths, missing image dimensions, and long URLs that break on mobile
  • Mobile Readiness Checklist — 12 instant checks including viewport meta tag, HTTPS, responsive theme detection, script/stylesheet count, jQuery Migrate, PHP version, and more
  • 3 One-Click Quick Fixes — Enable lazy loading, fix oversized images, and improve mobile font sizes with one click. Safe CSS injections that can be reverted instantly

Full Google PageSpeed Scan (Free API Key)

  • Scans up to 10 pages at mobile viewport using Google PageSpeed Insights
  • Tracks Core Web Vitals — LCP, CLS, and INP scores per page
  • Flags every issue with plain-English explanations (not developer jargon)
  • Maps each issue to its SEO impact so you know what to fix first
  • Provides fix suggestions — step-by-step guidance with code snippets you can use immediately
  • Mobile Preview — See your site rendered in phone, tablet, and desktop frames with issues highlighted
  • Color-coded severity — see at a glance what’s critical vs. minor

Issues MobileRank Detects

  • Layout shift (CLS) causing content to jump on mobile
  • Oversized images served at desktop resolution on phones
  • Missing lazy loading on off-screen images
  • Tap targets too small or too close together
  • Text too small to read without zooming
  • Render-blocking CSS and JavaScript
  • Missing or misconfigured viewport meta tag
  • Unused CSS and JavaScript wasting bandwidth
  • Slow Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
  • Missing text compression (gzip/brotli)
  • And more…

Who Is MobileRank For?

  • Site owners who see bad mobile PageSpeed scores but don’t know why
  • Bloggers dependent on Google organic traffic
  • WooCommerce store owners losing mobile conversions
  • Freelancers & agencies who need to diagnose and fix client sites

How It Works

  1. Install and activate MobileRank
  2. Mobi automatically runs Image Audit, Content Scanner, and Mobile Readiness Checklist — results in seconds
  3. Add a free Google API key in Settings for full PageSpeed scanning (optional but recommended)
  4. Click “Run Full Scan” to analyze up to 10 pages with Core Web Vitals
  5. See every issue mapped to SEO impact with step-by-step fix guidance

Free Version Includes

  • Image Audit, Content Scanner, and Mobile Readiness Checklist (no API key required)
  • 3 one-click Quick Fixes (lazy loading, responsive images, mobile fonts)
  • Scan up to 10 pages with Google PageSpeed Insights
  • Core Web Vitals tracking (LCP, CLS, INP)
  • Mobile Preview with phone, tablet, and desktop frames
  • SEO impact mapping for every issue
  • Fix suggestions with code snippets
  • Email scan reports
  • Score tracking with before/after comparison
  • Clean, modern dashboard with Mobi mascot

External Services

This plugin connects to the Google PageSpeed Insights API to analyze the mobile performance of your website pages.

Google PageSpeed Insights API

  • What it does: Runs Google Lighthouse audits on your pages to measure mobile performance, Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), and detect mobile usability issues.
  • When data is sent: Only when you manually click “Run Scan” or when a scheduled scan runs (if configured). No data is sent automatically on plugin activation or page load.
  • What data is sent: The public URL of the page being scanned. No personal data, cookies, or user information is transmitted.
  • Service provider: Google LLC
  • Terms of Service: Google APIs Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy

The standalone features (Image Audit, Mobile Readiness Checklist, and Content Scanner) run entirely on your server and do not connect to any external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mobilerank folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the MobileRank menu item in your admin sidebar
  4. Click “Run Your First Scan” to analyze your site

Optional: Google API Key

MobileRank works without an API key, but adding one increases scanning speed. Get a free key from the Google Cloud Console.

Enter your key in MobileRank → Settings → Google PageSpeed API Key.
sections.faq:
Does MobileRank slow down my site?

No. MobileRank only runs in the WordPress admin dashboard. It doesn’t add any code, scripts, or styles to your frontend. Visitors to your site are completely unaffected.

Do I need a Google API key to use MobileRank?

No. Three features work instantly with zero configuration: Image Audit, Mobile Readiness Checklist, and Content Scanner. These scan your site entirely on your server. For the full Google PageSpeed scan, an API key is recommended for reliable results. The key is free and takes 2 minutes to set up.

How is this different from running PageSpeed Insights manually?

PageSpeed Insights gives you raw technical data. MobileRank translates that into visual, actionable results with plain-English explanations and copy-paste fixes. It also tracks your scores over time and scans multiple pages at once.

Does MobileRank replace my caching plugin?

No. MobileRank works alongside your existing performance stack (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, etc.). Your caching plugin handles delivery optimization. MobileRank handles mobile responsiveness and usability issues that caching can’t fix.

Does MobileRank replace Yoast or Rank Math?

No. SEO plugins handle meta tags, sitemaps, schema markup, and keyword optimization. MobileRank handles mobile performance and usability — the things Google’s mobile-first indexing actually measures. They complement each other.

What are Core Web Vitals?

Core Web Vitals are Google’s metrics for measuring real-world user experience: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) measures loading speed, CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) measures visual stability, and INP (Interaction to Next Paint) measures responsiveness. MobileRank tracks all three for every scanned page.

Will the Quick Fixes break my site?

The Quick Fixes are safe, low-risk CSS adjustments injected via your site’s head. They don’t modify any theme files or database content. Each fix can be reverted with one click from the dashboard.

Why is the free version limited to 10 pages?

The Google PageSpeed Insights API has rate limits, and each page scan takes several seconds. 10 pages covers the most important pages on most small-to-medium sites (homepage, key landing pages, popular posts).

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. MobileRank is a diagnostic tool that works with any WordPress theme. The fix suggestions are universal CSS/HTML/PHP solutions that apply regardless of your theme.

What does the Image Audit check for?

It scans your entire media library for images missing alt text (hurts SEO and accessibility), images over 500KB (slows mobile loading), images not in WebP or AVIF format (larger file sizes), and images in your content missing width and height attributes (causes layout shift).

How often should I run a scan?

After making significant changes to your site — new theme, new plugins, major content updates, or before/after optimization work. You can also set up scheduled scans in Settings to run automatically on a weekly basis.
